_comment: Allowlist of intentional geometry gaps. Only truly hidden interior parts, articulating components needing clearance, and thin structural elements that can't practically show contact belong here.

patterns.reason: Landing gear nose strut requires articulation clearance
Landing gear braces require articulation clearance
Rear ramps/doors require articulation clearance for opening
Clamshell door seams require articulation clearance
Gun yokes require elevation/traverse articulation clearance
Gun barrel root requires elevation clearance in mantlet
Gun sleeves require elevation clearance in mantlet
Machine gun ports require traverse clearance for firing
Aircraft antenna spine fairings: thin structural geometry
Aircraft tail stabilizers: thin structural attachment
Door windows recessed in frames by design
Door glass panels recessed in frames by design
Ammo boxes on weapon stations need clearance for reloading access
Coaxial MG barrel requires traverse clearance parallel to main gun
Muzzle reference sensor: thin structural geometry on barrel tip
Sprocket hub: center touches wheel body, tips protrude 2.5cm for track guide
Idler hub: center touches wheel body, tips protrude 2.5cm for track guide
ERA bolt heads stand proud of ERA panel surface
Turret cheek ERA bolts stand proud of panel surface
Gun barrel fume extractor: sleeve has clearance around barrel by design
Bore evacuator sleeve: same as fume extractor, clearance around barrel
Weapon pistol grip requires operator hand clearance
